title: The Caterpillar's Careful Feet
youtube_title: The Caterpillar's Careful Feet | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A small beautiful thing can be shared with the eyes only.
summary: At a harbor wall at low tide, Golda finds a caterpillar whose feet were more careful than fingers. The wish to pocket it or poke it is real, but Golda shows Eshe how to look without disturbing it. the ferryman looks too, and they leave it where it is.
